content: Hello! how can I help today?
I rent my lake house part of the year. How should I report this?
If you rent it out for **more than 14 days**, and use it for **personal purposes less than 14 days or 10% of rental days**, treat it as a **rental property** per IRS Pub 527.
How do I allocate expenses between personal and rental use?
Prorate based on **days rented vs. total days used**. Only rental-period expenses (like utilities, repairs, depreciation) are deductible on **Schedule E**.
Yes, on the **rental-use percentage** of the building and improvements. Use **Form 4562** for MACRS depreciation on your Schedule E property.
Passive activity loss rules under **IRC §469** apply. If your AGI is under $100K, up to **$25,000 in losses** may be deductible, phasing out above that.
